segments.description: A man in a garden takes a photo of a glowing flower with his smartphone to identify it.
A man indoors explains how to use Google Lens on a smartphone with animated UI elements floating around him.
An animated boy uses Google Lens in various settings like a library, market, and futuristic studio space.

hook.opening_visual: A young man crouches in a vibrant garden, looking confused at a glowing exotic flower.
hook.notes: Introduces the problem of identifying unknown plants or objects in a visual and engaging setting.
